kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app. store/apps/MyFinance.json:15 primary_category FINANCE; `grep -rn kidsAgeBand store/ratings` -> 0 hits; no KIDS category. Spec user is an adult paid on a fixed rhythm (MyFinance.md:49).

banner.where: lib/app/widgets.dart:446-469 AdvertisementRow (labelled 'Advertisement' + AglAdBanner), placed at lib/features/ledger/ledger_screen.dart:199 and lib/features/plan/plan_screen.dart:67

interstitial.why: Not used: grep for onTransition/Interstitial in lib/ finds 0 hits. This is a personal-finance context, where the founder rule says to remove interstitials. The spec removes the tab-change interstitial (MyFinance.md:208).

native.why: Sensitive finance context. The only scrolling lists are the user's own transactions (lib/features/ledger/ledger_screen.dart:188-197) and schedules/budgets (Plan). These are personal-data screens, not browse or discovery lists, so the founder rule says no native ads.

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota or premium tier ('limit' hits are budget monthly limits, lib/app/forms.dart:754-841). CSV export is free (lib/features/settings/settings_screen.dart:27-33,108-112). The spec bans 'premium' copy (MyFinance.md:206).

blockers: agl_ads must be re-resolved to include agl-manifest cb21ee5 (AglNativeAd / showRewarded): pubspec.lock resolved-ref is 7b3c98edc563f9bfdf90e6b91def17b4c4d20de3, which `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 7b3c98edc563f9bfdf90e6b91def17b4c4d20de3` reports does NOT contain cb21ee5 (pubspec.lock:17).
